Question 8
?

Which integral gives the area of the finite region bounded by y=f(x)=2x2−3x+2 and y=g(x)=3x−2, shown above?

(Note: Figure not drawn to scale)

a
∫12(−2x2+6x−4)dx
b
∫4/32(2x2−3x+2)dx
c
∫14/3(3x−2)dx
d
∫12(2x2−6x+4)dx
e
∫14/3(2x2−x−2)dx
